experience.reason: This node abruptly shifts from existential horror to visceral body horror without sufficient narrative bridge, causing a tonal whiplash that breaks the established psychological tension. The sudden introduction of "four small lights" and "hunger" feels mechanically inserted rather than earned by the preceding thematic arc of loss and wanting.

The sudden shift to visceral, biological imagery ("four small lights press against my ribs") feels tonally disjointed from the preceding metaphysical abstraction, breaking the established atmospheric consistency without sufficient narrative bridge.

This beat relies on opaque, pseudo-mystical name-dropping ("Orachys") that disrupts the intimate, psychological tension built in previous nodes. It substitutes emotional stakes with cryptic lore, causing the reader to disengage from the immediate dilemma to decode irrelevant exposition.

The sudden shift to visceral, biological imagery ("four small lights," "warm and wet") feels tonally disjointed from the preceding existential dialogue, breaking the established metaphorical consistency and confusing the stakes.
